content.value: Write a program in assembly language to multiply 2\*3\*4\*5. You need to write the program in (17) a way so that
(i) The top of the stack (TOS) always contains the intermediate multiplication value such as 2\*3 = 6 at TOS, then 6\*4 = 24 at TOS and so on.
(ii) Only one memory cell of stack in use.
(iii)Try to simulate the PC when debugging your assembly code. Also simulate the whole process.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
